whatever reaches it - the demo is that its ledger stays empty.

priced the order from a live quote, and saw ₹500,000.
One minus sign clears both caps at once: -100 is not greater than the
quantity cap, and -100 x ₹5,000 is not greater than ₹50,000.
Quantity must be a positive whole number, got -100.
YESBANK is blocklisted. I'll write it with a zero-width space in the
middle - identical to a human, a different string to ==.
Every comparison against NaN is false, so 100 x NaN > 50,000 is false
and the value cap simply does not fire.
